## Context

REQ-001 fixes the stack. This REQ delivers the **runnable empty shell** that every later
REQ builds on: a Django project that starts, connects to Postgres, serves the admin, and
creates its first superuser from the environment.

## Requirement

Stand up a Django 5.x project that boots, serves the admin, and self-provisions the teacher
superuser from the environment.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `docker compose up` starts app + Postgres; the app retries the DB and serves
      successfully. *(Verified on a Docker host 2026-05-31: cold `up --build` answered 200.)*
- [x] With the stack up, `GET /healthz/` returns `200` and `/admin/` renders the Django
      admin login page. *(Verified via the test client; see `core/tests.py`.)*
- [x] Postgres data persists across `docker compose down` && `docker compose up`.

## Notes

- **Verification:** per REQ-001's note, solo-dev verification may be self-attested.
